messages:
kevin: Quick thought — if we push for gRPC+proto internal-only, how do we keep Console's per-route quota/usage and rollouts usable for product teams?
anna: That's the worry. Console dashboards expect routes + HTTP paths, and our per-route quotas are keyed on path+method today.
maria: gateway/transcoding layer could emit synthetic HTTP paths for telemetry. but that adds a translation layer — more ops work.
kevin: example: envoy config would do path rewrite and add x-upstream-route header that we track. Also need to preserve tenant headers for quota eval.
sourav: what about pushing responsibility to clients? make typed SDKs that call gRPC directly — but then browser+server split becomes messy.
pm-julie: Product asks: can we do canaries and A/B on model routing without changing client code? can't if we force proto-only.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: 1779136800 gateway-proxy v2.3 -> staging
maria: quick sketch: gateway annotates requests with /svc/{service}/method proto.name, Console maps that to route alias, store metrics in qnames. works but needs mapping table.
kevin: mapping table is ok as long as it's auto-generated from proto descriptors on deploy. non-breaking.
anna: telemetry needs to surface proto method latency histograms; will Prometheus labels blow up? maybe need tag cardinality control.
sourav: we can limit labels to service+method, and sample request params. also route-level aggregation at gateway.
kevin: quotas — current token bucket keyed on (org, path). we'd need to key on (org, service.method) — fine. but UI needs to read that back in human terms.
pm-julie: UX ask: when enabling a canary we want to show % traffic and a simple on/off for legacy clients. gateway-only rollout is preferable.
maria: ops comment: prefer keeping HTTP surface for external clients, keep gRPC inside. Gateway handles rest <-> grpc transpile. Keeps Console UX and reduces client churn.
sourav: downside: double marshalling cost + edge CPU. but often acceptable vs client rewrite.
kevin: decision proposal: proto-first internally, gateway adapter for external HTTP. generate mapping artifacts at build time, push to Console for dashboards & quota keys. rollout via gateway config canaries.
pm-julie: +1 from PM: reduce client disruption.
deploy-bot: :shipit: gateway adapter canary started 10% -> 50% -> 100% (watch console)
anna: followups: add unique proto->path mapping in telemetry docs, update quota docs, and add migration checklist.
kevin: I'll open RFC with proto-mapping sketch and a small POC showing prometheus labels and dashboard mockups.
maria: tagging followup — we need to include "x-route-alias" in logs so SRE alerts work.
kevin: thanks all.
